SCC.HealthOrange: Orange health bar at or below (%)
SCC.HealthRed: Red health bar at or below (%)
SCC.HealthOverlay: Red portrait overlay at or below (%)
SCC.HealthThresholdHint: Threshold from 0 to 100 percent of maximum HP. Red takes priority over orange when thresholds overlap; the overlay is independent. Applies only to GM health indicators, including the mini view.
SCC.NoSheetAccess: This character sheet is unavailable or you do not have permission to view it.
SCC.PlayersStartedName: Players: show only after combat starts
SCC.PlayersStartedHint: Hide the carousel from players until combat starts. The GM controls this setting for all players.
SCC.GMStartedName: GM: show only after combat starts
SCC.GMStartedHint: Also hide the carousel from GMs until combat starts. When disabled, GMs can use it during combat preparation.
SCC.ImageSourceHint: Choose actor portraits or scene token images for all participants. Falls back to the other source if an image is missing. Also applies to the mini view.
SCC.OnlyStartedHint: The carousel appears after the GM starts combat. Prepare combatants in the regular Combat Tracker beforehand.
SCC.PlayersOnlyHint: Players see PCs only. An anonymous placeholder appears during NPC turns, followed by the next visible PC. The GM view remains complete.
SCC.ActionFailed: Simple Combat Carousel: Action failed. See the console for details.
SCC.Conflict: Two combat carousels are enabled. Disable Carousel Combat Tracker to avoid duplicate displays.
SCC.LanguageHint: Choose the module language independently of Foundry. Reload to update settings labels as well.
SCC.CollapsedHint: Show a compact bar at the top center with the current and next combatant.
SCC.HealthHint: Show health bars to the GM only. Players never see hit points in the carousel.
